name: CommerceMegaMenu
tagline: The Commerce Mega Menu is the large, multi-column navigation you see on modern enterprise and online-shop websites.
description: The Commerce Mega Menu is the large, multi-column navigation you see on modern enterprise and online-shop websites. A bar across the top lists the main sections (for example Products, Solutions, Resources, Services and Contact). Choosing a section opens a wide panel with grouped links, small icons, one-line descriptions, badges such as New, Popular, Beta or Updated, highlighted "featured" links, a promotional card and "View all" links.
features: Top navigation bar with large multi-column panels
Descriptions and badges, featured links, promotional card
Driven by a JSON menu configuration
Raises the selected link through output properties (or navigates, if you choose)
